aubergine-ink.$description: Aubergine Ink — Primary text, borders, dividers, icon strokes — the structural backbone of every surface

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Card surfaces, badge fills, nav background — the elevated layer above the canvas

warm-linen.$description: Warm Linen — Page canvas and page-level background — slightly warm off-white, never sterile

soft-mist.$description: Soft Mist — Hairline borders, list dividers, subtle separators between list items and sections

pale-silver.$description: Pale Silver — Link borders, secondary borders, muted outlines on ghost elements

cloud-veil.$description: Cloud Veil — Secondary card backgrounds, subtle surface differentiation

periwinkle-tint.$description: Periwinkle Tint — Soft blue-tinted card borders — the gentler cousin of the accent

carbon.$description: Carbon — Icon fills, certain link text — used sparingly where maximum contrast is needed

smoke.$description: Smoke — Muted secondary text, nav borders, low-emphasis icon strokes

plum-depth.$description: Plum Depth — Headlines, event titles, and deep emphasis text — the voice of large type

indigo-slate.$description: Indigo Slate — Nav borders, secondary structural lines, quieter sibling of Aubergine Ink

electric-iris.$description: Electric Iris — Violet accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Orange wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

neue-plak.$description: All UI text — body, headings, buttons, badges, nav, event titles. The custom geometric sans carries the entire interface; no second typeface is needed.

neue-plak-text.$description: Semi-bold companion for nav and select UI labels where extra weight is needed at small sizes
